items.title: Scandal-hit Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits, plunging AI chipmaking giant into turmoil
items.description: US lawmakers now want to question him over whether one of his alleged relationships was with a Chinese spy.

items.title: US envoys meet Zelensky in Dublin after talks with Putin in Moscow
items.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.

items.title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?
items.description: The army has taken control of most of Tigray's main towns - it is unclear if the TPLF is capable of fighting back.

items.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
items.description: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.

items.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
items.description: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.

items.title: Australian footballers will not be charged after hotel incident, police say
items.description: Four Sydney Swans players had been under investigation after an alleged sexual assault after a game in Melbourne.

items.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
items.description: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

items.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
items.description: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.

items.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
items.description: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns

items.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
items.description: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

items.title: Five new miniature frog species found in eastern Himalayas
items.description: Scientists say the frogs evolved as the Himalayas rose and the Asian monsoon took shape.

items.title: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
items.description: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.
